fit_reason: This is an engine-only listing (a new outboard motor), and it is dealer stock from Riverview Sports and Marine despite the private seller tag. It is not a whole vehicle a private owner is selling.
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Yamaha outboard. We do mobile pre-sale detailing and gelcoat polishing for boats, so if you ever have a complete boat you want looking its best for buyers, we'd be glad to give you a quote.
